comments.author: @gubzs
comments.text:
People will have to get used to full monitoring with cutting edge AI for the foreseeable future, there are air tight reasons for it that aren't hard to explain:
1) Modern models will be increasingly capable of severe social scale harm, from cyber terrorism, to bioengineering, to scams and blackmail
2) Modern models are not reliably capable of avoiding fulfillment of these harmful requests
3) Therefore human oversight over flagged suspicious AI usage is a requirement to prevent the problems above

And that's why your model will flag suspicious things. There is no other way to prevent this, and even this is not enough to guarantee something awful won't happen. Like Eric Schmidt says, we are probably heading towards a Chernobyl-level casualty event, as that will be what is required to wake people up to AI safety.
